1.explanation:
• ComboBox.js passes the onClick prop from the user down into the ListBoxField (the underlying component) but doesn’t alter how clicks on the arrow icon are handled.  
• ListBoxField.js renders both the <input> (with onClick hooked up to the user’s handler) and the arrow icon (with its own internal toggleMenu click handler). It never invokes the user’s onClick when the arrow is clicked.  
• ListBoxMenuIcon.js defines the arrow toggle UI and its own click handling for opening/closing the menu, but it doesn’t forward that event to the parent’s onClick.  

To fix this bug, the arrow icon’s click handler in ListBoxField (or inside ListBoxMenuIcon) needs to be updated to call the user’s onClick in addition to toggling the menu state. This ensures that clicking the arrow always invokes the user’s fetch routine on first click.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided example the <ComboBox> is mounted with an onClick handler that fetches (or simulates) its list of items. When the user clicks into the text input portion of the Combobox, the onClick fires, the items load, and then clicking the arrow opens the list properly. However, if the user clicks the arrow icon first—before the input has ever been clicked—the onClick never fires, no AJAX call is made, and the list remains empty (even though the arrow flips). Only subsequent arrow clicks (after the list is already populated) work correctly. In short: the down‐arrow button toggles the dropdown but doesn’t invoke the user’s onClick until after the input has been clicked once.

2.explanation:
• ComboBox.js accepts an onClick prop and spreads it into the ListBoxField props, but only the input element picks it up.  
• ListBoxField.js renders both the <input> (which gets the user’s onClick) and the menu icon, but its icon click is wired only to toggle Downshift’s menu – it never invokes the forwarded onClick.  
• ListBoxMenuIcon.js itself only knows how to flip the caret, so clicking it never bubbles into the ComboBox’s onClick.  
To fix this, the component wiring in ListBoxField (or MenuIcon) must be updated to call the passed onClick callback when the icon is clicked, not only when the input is clicked.
2.bug_scenario: When you render a <ComboBox> and pass an onClick handler (to fetch items via AJAX), clicking the text input fires that callback and populates the menu, but clicking the down-caret icon only toggles the menu open (you see the caret flip) and never invokes your onClick, so the list remains empty until you click the input itself.
